Track B: Multimodal Modeling & Task Family Evaluation

nodes.label:
ClinicalTrials.gov XML Registry
Comprehensive clinical trial protocol records
NCT IDs, study design, phase & interventions
Eligibility criteria and reported outcomes

External Clinical Knowledge Bases
DrugBank chemical & molecular structures
TrialTrove trial success & termination records
ICD-10 & CCS hierarchical disease ontologies

Cross-Modal Entity Linking
Link interventions to DrugBank SMILES graphs
Normalize conditions to ICD-10/CCS codes
Map outcomes to unique trial NCT identifiers

Pre-Event Feature Guard Gate
Was feature available prior to target event?
Eliminate post-outcome data leakage?
Filter constant/all-null fields or retain

Task Eligibility Filter Gate
Does trial satisfy task-specific constraints?
Meets phase, sample size, or therapy criteria?
Filter unqualified trials or route to task builders

Multimodal Label Construction
Derive binary, continuous, and event targets
Extract durations from dates and trial counts
GPT-assisted eligibility criteria formalization

TrialBench Curated Suite
23 AI-ready multimodal benchmark datasets
Structured across 5 distinct data modalities
Standardized train, validation, and test splits

Multimodal Feature Encoding
Encode SMILES graphs, ICD-10 codes, and text
Embed tabular numerical & categorical features
Fuse multimodal representations into task heads

Prediction Task Routing Gate
Route to target challenge family:
Classification · Regression · Generation
Dispatch inputs to evaluation pipelines

Trial Classification Evaluation
Approval prediction & phase transition
Evaluate PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, F1 & Accuracy
Assess trial success and adverse risk detection

Trial Regression Evaluation
Enrollment duration & patient count modeling
Evaluate RMSE, MAE, Pearson & Concordance Index
Measure clinical trial timeline prediction

Trial Generation Evaluation
Eligibility criteria & protocol text generation
Evaluate BLEU, ROUGE & BertScore metrics
Measure clinical rationale coherence

TrialBench Evaluation Summary
Cross-modality ablation & benchmark matrix
Model clinical trial design capability profile
Unified clinical AI prediction leaderboard
